title: Switzerland
desc: Shibu and Rumi lead a middle-class family life with their children and can only afford to go to local destinations for holidays. One day, they decide to save money for a trip to Switzerland.

title: Parineeta
desc: Childhood sweethearts Lalita and Shekhar wish to get married someday. However, Shekhar's growing suspicions about Lalita coupled with his conniving father's antics threaten to tear them apart.

title: Putuler Protisodh
desc: Bini, a married woman, is murdered by her in-laws, following which her spirit possesses a doll. As she decides to seek revenge, her husband's second wife must free her spirit.

title: Annaye Atyachar
desc: An inebriated Udayan spends a night with his friend's daughter, Kunti, mistaking her to be his wife. He leaves unaware the next morning, setting off a chain of chaotic events.

title: Bancharamer Bagan
desc: Bancharam, a poor peasant, turns his barren land into a thriving garden, only to face a cunning landlord who stops at nothing to take it away from him.
